title.en: How do you read Electric 50 stone rows on a building?
title.zh: 建筑工地上怎么读电动50的石子行？

description.en: Electric 50 prints three distance rows: fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm 80 m / 240 m, 24 mm 60 m / 180 m, at 55 kW and 26 m³/h.
description.zh: 电动50印了三行距离：细石 150 m / 350 m、13 mm 80 m / 240 m、24 mm 60 m / 180 m，电机 55 kW、输送量 26 m³/h。

h1.en: How do you read Electric 50 stone rows on a building?
h1.zh: 建筑工地上怎么读电动50的石子行？

directAnswer.en: Read the row that names the stone. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 50 as 55 kW, 26 m³/h, 30 MPa and hopper 0.4 m³. Fine stone is 150 m horizontal / 350 m vertical. 13 mm stone is 80 m / 240 m. 24 mm stone is 60 m / 180 m. The frame is 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm and 2800 kg. The published use is building and commercial placement.
directAnswer.zh: 读与石子同名的那一行。邢台河北品锦机械把电动50印成 55 kW、26 m³/h、30 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³。细石是水平 150 m / 垂直 350 m。13 mm 石子是 80 m / 240 m。24 mm 石子是 60 m / 180 m。外形 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm，整机 2800 kg。公布用途是建筑与商业浇筑。

heading.en: Why the 350 m figure is easy to misuse
heading.zh: 为什么 350 m 容易用错

body.en: 350 m is the fine-stone vertical cell, paired with 150 m horizontal. A 24 mm mix uses 60 m / 180 m. A 13 mm mix uses 80 m / 240 m. The output cell stays 26 m³/h on all three rows. It is not three different pumps and it is not a licence to use the longest number for every mix.
body.zh: 350 m 是细石垂直格，配对的水平是 150 m。24 mm 的料用 60 m / 180 m。13 mm 的料用 80 m / 240 m。三行的输送量都是 26 m³/h。这不是三台泵，也不能拿最长的数字套每一种料。

heading.en: Where does Electric 50 sit against Electric 40?
heading.zh: 电动50相对电动40在哪一档？

body.en: The selection guide places both on medium buildings when the grid is available. Electric 40 is 21 m³/h with fine stone 120 m / 360 m and aggregate 13 at 40 m / 120 m. Electric 50 steps the output to 26 m³/h and adds an explicit 24 mm row. Without grid power, the same guide points at Diesel 40 / Diesel 50 instead of stretching this 55 kW motor.
body.zh: 选型指南把两台都放在有电网的中型建筑上。电动40是 21 m³/h，细石 120 m / 360 m，13 骨料 40 m / 120 m。电动50把输送量提到 26 m³/h，并单独印了 24 mm 行。没有电网时，同一份指南指向柴油40 / 柴油50，而不是硬用这台 55 kW 电机。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Name the stone row: fine stone, 13 mm or 24 mm. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请点名石子行：细石、13 mm 或 24 mm。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Is 26 m³/h different for 24 mm stone?
question.zh: 24 mm 石子的输送量不是 26 m³/h 吗？

answer.en: The output cell is printed once, as 26 m³/h. The distance cells change with stone size. Do not invent a second output.
answer.zh: 输送量格只印了一次，是 26 m³/h。距离格随石子变化。不要另编一个输送量。

question.en: What is the hydraulic pump cell?

answer.en: Kawasaki 140, as printed. It does not replace the stone-row check.
answer.zh: 印的是川崎 140。它不能代替石子行核对。

question.en: Is this a high-rise model by name?
question.zh: 它的名称是高层型号吗？

answer.en: The high-rise phrase is on Electric 60. Electric 50 is building and commercial placement with the three stone rows above.
answer.zh: “高层”这句话在电动60上。电动50是建筑与商业浇筑，加上面的三行石子。
